bias.zh: 偏空 · 逼近 200 日均线

read.en: Teradyne rose 2.6% on Oct 21 to $345.49, trading between $341.51 and $351.95. It is above the falling 5-day average ($337.2) but just below the rising 200-day ($346.7), and below the falling 10-day ($361.1), 30-day ($380.0) and 100-day ($380.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($390.64), and RSI is 41.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 10月21日上涨 2.6%，收于 $345.49，盘中区间 $341.51–351.95。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（$337.2）上方，但略低于上行的 200 日均线（$346.7），并低于下行的 10 日（$361.1）、30 日（$380.0）和 100 日均线（$380.3）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$390.64），RSI 为 41。

read.en: The close cleared $343 (Oct 20 high) and the 5-day, but the high faded and the close stayed under the 200-day. Resistance is $346.7–352 (200-day, day's high), then $361 (10-day) and $380 (30 and 100-day). Support is $341.5 (day's low), then $332 and $322.3 (Oct 20 low). A close above $352 would target $361; a close below $332 would reopen $322.
read.zh: 收盘突破 $343（10月20日高点）和 5 日均线，但盘中高点回落，收盘仍在 200 日均线下方。阻力为 $346.7–352（200 日均线、当日高点），其次 $361（10 日均线）和 $380（30 日和 100 日均线）。支撑为 $341.5（当日低点），其次 $332 和 $322.3（10月20日低点）。若收盘站上 $352，下一目标看 $361；若收盘跌破 $332，将重新打开 $322。
